description: List transaction ids currently in the full node mempool. By default returns the first `limit` ids (default 100, max 1000) plus a `truncated` flag. Pass `include_items: true` to also return the full mempool items (warning: can be large on a busy mempool).

include_items.description: If true, also fetch full mempool items via get_all_mempool_items.

limit.description: Maximum number of tx_ids (and items) to return. 1..1000.

name: get_mempool
